firstPass.prompt: Pixel-art animation revision for the existing Unity action game. EDIT TARGET Image 1 is the approved ORIGINAL six-frame running strip. The body's low forward lean, skull orientation, eye line and silhouette stay almost fixed while only legs alternate; tiny, gentle hair tip and coat movement. Preserve the original pose and 0.85s running rhythm. Carefully clean up pixel placement: consistent crisp dark 1-native-pixel silhouette, connected intentional pixel clusters, legible face and hands and shoes, coherent fabric folds; no noisy isolated pixels, no fine fuzzy shading, no vector-like smoothing. She must be the SAME exact girl as Idle: warm rose-pink twin tails, exact bangs and black beaded accessories, cream cardigan, burgundy ribbon, black pleated skirt with pink edging, white socks and brown shoes. Physical head-to-torso-to-leg proportions exactly like Idle; the lower crouch is only pose, not a smaller girl. Use consistent character scale and the SAME head dimensions and near-identical head position in all six frames. Ground contact stable, no sudden foot slides, clear six-phase stride with distinct alternating left and right foot. Only two arms and two legs. Sprite in each cell isolated on genuinely transparent background, no ball, no chain, no ground, no glow, no halo, no text, generous transparent margin. Output individual pixel art game sprites, not a portrait or illustration.

Improve the hair: both twin tails gently STREAM OUTWARD and partly UPWARD, suspended behind and above the shoulders by falling air; individual pointed tapered locks with readable silhouette, lively 'basa' shape halfway between normal idle and a big wind gust. Keep the head, face, torso, hands and legs practically identical in BOTH frames, with a small 1–2 pixel difference only at the outer hair ends; she settles into the second frame and holds it, no flapping cycle. The upper torso stays the same size as Idle, no chibi proportion change, no scale pulsing. Coat floats a little with pointed hem, not enormous sleeves. Faithful rose hair, cream cardigan, burgundy bow, black skirt, pale socks, brown shoes, black hair bands. Crisp clean game-native pixel clusters, no blurry gradients, smooth silhouettes or fake pixels. Two complete equal-sized sprites centered in two equal cells with enough transparent margins for hair and baton, genuinely transparent background, no text, no ball, no chain, no effects.
